edges: The inspectors at the International Atomic Energy Agency may inspect military sites.

multi_hop_neighbors.edge: Iran's nuclear activities, specifically uranium enrichment, will have restrictions eased or eliminated over time.
Iran is allowed to keep one-third of its centrifuges while its nuclear program continues.
Harsh international sanctions brought Iran to the negotiating table.
The outlines of a nuclear deal with Iran are in place.
The strictest restrictions on Iran's enrichment will expire in 10 years.

The restrictions and obligations in the final framework agreement will be imposed almost exclusively on Iran, while the P5+1 are obligated to ease and eventually remove most but not all economic sanctions.
The framework announced last week does nothing of the sort.
Iran is the subject of a worthy, desirable goal of reaching a good solid agreement.
